phoneInbox.text: Cut every one of your preseason shifts. Forty minutes of it. Want it tonight or after the first game?

choices.label: Tonight
choices.reply: Send it tonight. I'll watch it twice

choices.label: After the first game
choices.reply: After the opener. I want to play free first

phoneInbox.text: We're roommates at the World Juniors camp apparently. I'm bringing the card game. You're bringing snacks.

choices.label: Deal
choices.reply: Deal. I'll bring enough for the whole floor

choices.label: I need sleep
choices.reply: Lights out at ten for me, sorry man

phoneInbox.text: Watched you on TV Saturday. Still remember you at 15 refusing to dump the puck in like I told you. Proud of you kid.

choices.label: Thank him properly
choices.reply: Everything started with you coach. Tickets for you whenever you want, for life

phoneInbox.text: That playoff beard is a whole personality at this point. Shave it live on stream for the children's charity?

choices.label: Shave it for charity
choices.reply: Chair. Tomorrow. Do your worst, it's for a good cause

choices.label: Keep the beard
choices.reply: Sorry, this thing is staying until we're eliminated or we win it all

phoneInbox.text: Same pregame meal every game until we lose. Same seat on the bus too. You in on it or are you going to jinx us?

choices.label: I'm in, same everything
choices.reply: Same pasta, same seat, same socks. Don't talk to me about it

choices.label: Not superstitious
choices.reply: I'm eating what I want, we'll be fine
